title: Streets Full of Children
old_p1: Long ago, Jerusalem was broken, and many people had to go far away. Zechariah told of a happy day to come.
The Lord said, “I will live in Jerusalem.” His mountain there would be called the holy mountain. Holy means very special to Heavenly Father.
Old men and old women would be in the streets, each with a walking stick because they were so old.
old_p2: And the streets would be full of boys and girls playing! Zechariah used that picture to show how a holy city feels: safe, kind and happy, for young and old.
Your home can feel like that city too. Tonight, think of one kind thing you can do tomorrow for a grandma, grandpa or friend.
p1: Many people had lived far away from Jerusalem. Now some had come home. Zechariah told them about a happy day to come.
“I will come back and live in Jerusalem,” said the Lord. It would be a city of truth. His mountain there would be holy, very special to Heavenly Father.
There would be old men and old women in the streets again. Each would hold a walking stick, because they were so old.
p2: And the streets would be full of boys and girls playing! Young and old would be safe and happy together.
Your home can feel like that city too. Tonight, think of a kind thing to do for a grandma, grandpa or friend.
